# Burlington Snow Co.

> Burlington Snow Co. is a local, insured snow removal company in Burlington, Ontario, Canada. Season plans (November to April) clear the driveway, walkway and front steps every time 5 cm or more of snow falls, including the snowbank the city plow leaves. Driveways are cleared within 6 hours of the snow stopping (12 hours for storms over 20 cm) or that visit is free.

## Contact
- Call or text: 647 504 5210
- Website: https://burlingtonsnowco.ca/
- Service area: Burlington, Ontario only

## Season prices (CAD, plus HST, walkway and front steps included)
- Townhouse: $499
- Single car: $649
- Double car: $799
- Large (5+ cars): $999
- Payment: nothing due when booking online; after confirmation by text, pay by Interac e-Transfer, half up front and half on January 1
- Commercial sites (condos, plazas, offices): quoted per site

## Neighbourhoods served
Aldershot, Alton Village, Brant Hills, Downtown Burlington, Headon Forest, Millcroft, Orchard, Palmer, Roseland, Shoreacres, Tansley, Tyandaga

## Customer reviews
5 reviews from Burlington customers, all 5 stars, shown on the homepage.

## FAQ
- **How much does snow removal cost in Burlington?** Our season plans run November to April and include the driveway, walkway and front steps. A townhouse is $499, a single car driveway is $649, a double car driveway is $799 and a large driveway (5 or more cars) is $999, plus HST. Commercial sites are quoted per site.
- **Which parts of Burlington do you serve?** All of Burlington, from Aldershot to Burloak Drive and from Lake Ontario to Dundas Street, plus Alton Village. That includes Tyandaga, Brant Hills, Headon Forest, Millcroft, Tansley, Orchard, Palmer, Downtown, Roseland and Shoreacres.
- **When do you come?** Every time 5 cm or more falls, November to April. You're cleared automatically. You don't need to call.
- **What counts as the walkway?** The path from your driveway to your front door, plus the front steps.
- **Do you offer any discounts?** Yes. Book with a neighbour on the same street and you each save $50 on your season plan. Just add their name and address when you book.
- **Do you clear the snowbank the city plow leaves?** Yes. The end of your driveway is cleared on every visit.
- **How do I pay?** Nothing is due when you book. Once we confirm your spot by text, you pay by Interac e-Transfer: half to start your season and half on January 1.
- **Are you insured?** Yes. Burlington Snow Co. carries liability insurance for every property we clear.
